target_audience: University students with a basic interest in computer science and cryptography

sections.title: Introduction: Cryptographic Hash Functions
lecture_lines: Hash functions are digital fingerprints for data.
They are simple to compute one way.
animations: Create a hash box on screen #FFFFFF [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/fingerprint.svg].
Input data 'Blockchain' appears in the box.

sections.title: The Proof-of-Work Math: Solving the Puzzle
lecture_lines: Miners find a nonce for valid hashes.
Difficulty ensures a ten-minute block time.
animations: Display a 'nonce' variable on screen using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/computer.svg] with color #00FF00.
Increment 'nonce' value rapidly to find hash on [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/computer.svg].
Highlight hash starting with four zeros, color #FF0000, processed by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/server.svg].

sections.title: Public-Key Cryptography: Who Owns the Coins?
lecture_lines: Public keys are derived elliptic points.
animations: Show Public Key and Private Key as separate objects using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/key.svg].
Illustrate transaction being signed with Private Key [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/key.svg].
Verify signature with Public Key [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/key.svg], color #00FFFF.

sections.title: Digital Signatures: Proving Ownership
animations: Animate Private Key [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/key.svg] locking the data [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lock.svg].
Show Signature as a digital seal [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/seal.svg], color #FF00FF.

sections.title: Conclusion: The Security of the Chain
lecture_lines: Changing data breaks the hash link.
The chain remains immutable and secure.
animations: Display full chain of connected blocks using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/chain.svg].
Highlight how one [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/block.svg] links to previous.
